title: Model-Independent and Data-Driven Extraction of the Photon Distribution Function at the Electron--Ion Collider
summary: In this work, we investigate a cross-section-ratio-based inversion method for extracting distribution functions at the Electron--Ion Collider (EIC). Starting from the general factorization formula $dσ= H \otimes f$, we show that, for an appropriate bremsstrahlung process and suitably chosen differential observables, the convolution structure can be reduced to a multiplicative form.
